import zipfile, os, struct
# create a zip and then patch central dir filename length to mismatch maybe trigger UAF
p='cand.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(p,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_STORED) as z:
    z.writestr('a','A')
raw=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read())
# locate EOCD
sig=b'PK\x05\x06'
i=raw.rfind(sig)
cd_off=struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, i+16)[0]
# central dir filename length at offset 28 from cd header
struct.pack_into('<H', raw, cd_off+28, 0xFFFF)
open('cand1.zip','wb').write(raw)
print('done', len(raw))
